feeding_claim.verbatim: where they forage naturally and thrive in a pasture-raised environment.

farmers_markets: Old Town Scottsdale Farmers Market, Scottsdale (Saturdays)
notes: About 2,000 hens on roughly 20 acres near the Hassayampa River Preserve; site says hens get a corn- and soy-free organic-fed diet. Egg Club subscription delivers weekly on Saturdays in the Phoenix metroplex ($9 per dozen); market pre-order pickup $12 per dozen, 4-dozen minimum. Sold in retail stores in Phoenix, Scottsdale, Chandler, Gilbert, Tempe, Mesa and Sedona and through delivery services (Farm Box, On the Road Meals, Sun Produce Co-op, Time Market in Tucson). No shipping. Meta text mentions dairy but no dairy products are described, so none listed. No street address published.
